agyos_skill.intent: Diagnostic and design guide to eliminate AI-generated UI slop. Replaces generic purple gradients, Inter overuse, emoji icons, uniform 3-card grids, and synthetic floating blobs with production design.
agyos_skill.instructions: Engineering guidelines for detecting and eliminating the common visual signatures of generic, automated AI web generation, elevating interfaces to production standards. Signature Flaw: - Overuse of violet-to-fuchsia or generic indigo gradients (`from-purple-600 to-indigo-600`) as fallback hero backgrounds and button accents. Engineering Fix: - Implement a disciplined color architecture using CSS variables or Tailwind tokens: - High-contrast monochrome: Crisp black/white (`#0a0a0a` / `#fafafa`) with a single deliberate accent (emerald, amber, electric blue, or terracotta). - Test contrast ratios against WCAG AAA standards (7:1 for normal text, 4.5:1 for large controls). - Use subtle radial gradients with low opacity (3-8%) anchored to structural elements rather than generic full-viewport washes. Signature Flaw: - Defaulting to Inter or Roboto for all headers, labels, numbers, and body copy without typographic hierarchy. Engineering Fix: - Pair distinct display and body typefaces: - Technical / Modern: Geist Sans (body) + Geist Mono (data/code). - Architectural / Product: Plus Jakarta Sans or Cabinet Grotesk (display) + Inter/Public Sans (body). - Editorial / High-Trust: Instrument Serif or Playfair (display) + DM Sans (body). - Enforce strict optical scaling: `text-xs` (12px), `text-sm` (14px), `text-base` (16px), `text-xl` (20px), `text-3xl` (30px), `text-5xl` (48px). Signature Flaw: - Using emoji characters (🚀, 💡, ⚡, 🛡️) inside production cards, buttons, and navigation headers. Engineering Fix: - Use consistent vector icon libraries: Lucide Icons, Phosphor Icons, or Radix Icons. - Standardize stroke width (e.g., `stroke-width="1.75"` across all icons) and bounding box sizing (`16px`, `20px`, `24px`). - Wrap icons in accessible semantic wrappers (`aria-hidden="true"` on decorative icons, explicit labels on standalone buttons).
